Kamva 1.2.1 fixes the canvas going blank when a long song is on the timeline.

## Download (Windows 10/11, 64-bit)

- **Kamva-Setup-1.2.1.exe**: installer with Start menu and desktop shortcuts; opens `.kamva` files
- **Kamva-1.2.1-portable.exe**: single file, no install needed
- macOS (Apple silicon, .zip) and Linux (.AppImage) builds are attached when those builds succeed

The builds aren't code-signed. If SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**.

## Fixes

- **The page, video preview and right-hand controls no longer disappear when you add a long audio track.** A song much longer than your video made the timeline so wide that it stretched the whole window, which pushed the page, Play/Present/Export, the zoom bar and the side panel off-screen. The timeline now scrolls sideways on its own and everything else stays put.
- **The purple "drop here" outline around the canvas no longer gets stuck** after dragging files onto it.
